title: Iran Warns of New US Attack, Threatens 'Sustained Retaliation' Against US Bases and Regional Allies
detail: Iran's military central command said on state media that it possesses intelligence indicating preparations for a new, major US-led attack, and warned that any such action would trigger sustained retaliation against US bases and interests across the region. The command said Washington's regional allies would be treated as parties to the conflict if they supported the operation. Iran did not detail the intelligence it cited. The warning came as the US Embassy in Israel maintained a security alert over escalated Houthi-Saudi fighting following the Sept 19 strikes threatening Riyadh.
